observation_summary: The iterator allowed removal of elements from the internal list, failing the test case that expected an UnsupportedOperationException.
reasoning_summary: The ListPopulation class was exposing its internal list of chromosomes directly through the iterator() method. This allowed external code to modify the internal state of the population (e.g., removing chromosomes) by calling remove() on the iterator, bypassing any validation or encapsulation logic. The fix involved changing the iterator to return an iterator from getChromosomes(), which provides an unmodifiable view of the list, thereby preventing unauthorized modifications.
